fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the suspicious gNB/eNodeB via OSS with immediate RAN segmentation rules.
Enforce NAS security mode command (SMC) with mandatory integrity protection (128-bit keys).
Deploy NAS trace filtering to block IMSI attachment requests without valid subscriber data.
Update NEF/AMF to reject NAS_EPS_EMM_CAUSE=125 without prior authentication.
Enable 5G NAS replay attack detection with a 30-second timestamp window.
Configure RAN to enforce mandatory 5G NAS security mode (SM1) for all connections.
Set NAS trace alert threshold to trigger on >5 failed attachments per minute.
Update SMF to validate NAS messages against subscriber profiles pre-attachment.
Deploy NAS message signing verification for all NAS_EPS_EMM messages.
Audit NAS security configurations weekly for compliance with 3GPP TS 24.501.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Monitor Installed Applications For Data Usage
Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
